title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million after inspectors found 62 tractor trailer size natural gas generators at its Vineland data center site in late July. None of the 2,000 kilowatt generators had permits to be installed or operated. The state said the penalty for violating the Air Pollution Control Act is the largest ever issued to a data center operator in New Jersey. The campus is slated for completion at the end of the year.

The planned 2.6 million square foot complex would need 350 megawatts, enough to power a medium size city, and some of it is already in use. It has drawn complaints, including a federal lawsuit by homeowners over persistent noise and violation orders from the Cumberland County Health Department for excessive noise. Governor Mikie Sherrill said data centers should not be exempt from responsibility and should benefit New Jersey communities.
